Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Fouquet's ParisAwarded the prestigious Palace distinction; the highest accolade in French luxury hospitality; Hôtel Fouquet’s Paris invites guests into a world of unparalleled elegance. Ideally located at the corner of the Champs-Élysées and Avenue George V, this iconic five-star hotel embodies the very essence of Parisian refinement. From the moment of arrival, guests are welcomed into a magnificently redesigned lobby, where noble materials blend seamlessly with exquisite hand-blown glass masterpieces, setting the tone for an exceptional stay.

Each room and suite reflects the timeless sophistication and distinctive signature of renowned designer Jacques Garcia. True havens of serenity, they feature flat-screen televisions, minibars, and luxurious marble bathrooms with separate bathtubs and walk-in showers. Throughout their stay, guests enjoy privileged access to the hotel’s Spa, a sanctuary of well-being complete with a large heated indoor swimming pool, a modern fitness centre, a sauna, a hammam, and an invigorating ice room.

For memorable culinary moments, guests may immerse themselves in the vibrant atmosphere of the legendary Brasserie Fouquet’s, or opt for the intimate charm of Restaurant Joy and its enchanting private garden. As evening falls, the experience continues with bespoke cocktail creations crafted by our Director of Mixology, served in the sophisticated surroundings of L’Escadrille and Joy Bar. During the summer months, Le Rooftop becomes one of Paris’s most sought-after destinations, offering a stylish setting in which to embrace the season.

Benefiting from an exceptional location, Hôtel Fouquet’s Paris is just steps away from George V metro station and a five-minute walk from the Arc de Triomphe. The Eiffel Tower and the city’s most prestigious haute couture boutiques are within a twenty-minute stroll, making this Palace the ultimate address for a romantic Parisian escape or a distinguished business stay in the French capital.Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 9.8 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at The Peninsula ParisJust 400 metres from the Arc de Triomphe, the Peninsula offers a spa, a 22-metre indoor pool and a rooftop restaurant with 360° views over Paris. Standard room features include free WiFi, and free long-distance calls. Parc des Princes Stadium is only a 15-minute drive away.

All 200 rooms and suites are adorned with artworks and elegant furniture. Each offers a generous separate dressing area with expansive luggage and wardrobe space. The spacious marble bathrooms feature separate rain showers and deep soaking bathtubs, together with inset TVs, a nail dryer and luxurious bathroom amenities by Oscar de la Renta.

The Kléber Terrace is one of the largest outdoor dining terraces in Paris. L’Oiseau Blanc, the hotel’s rooftop restaurant, bar and terrace, serves contemporary French cuisine. Featuring Chinese and Western opera-inspired décor, the hotel’s Chinese restaurant, serves Cantonese cuisine.

The Peninsula is 1.1 km from Avenue des Champs-Elysées and 1.4 km from the Eiffel Tower. Paris-Charles de Gaulle Airport is 24 km away. An 57-space car park is available on site.Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 9.6 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

items.name: Hôtel Keppler
items.description:
Set in a 19th-century Haussmannian building, the luxurious Hotel Keppler is just 400 metres from the Champs Elysées. It offers a fitness centre, a sauna and a hammam, as well as a 24-hour front desk.

A flat-screen TV and a minibar are included in all of the air-conditioned guest rooms and suites. The private bathrooms have free toiletries, bath robes and slippers. All rooms are serviced by a lift and feature free WiFi access.

The bar at Hotel Keppler features a winter garden. An american buffet breakfast is served every morning in the dining room and guests can enjoy afternoon tea in the lounge.

George V Metro Station is located 450 metres away. With a private transfer service available at a surcharge, the hotel also offers a ticket service and tour desk.Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 9.6 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Fauchon l'Hôtel ParisSituated in Paris, a 8-minute walk from the Place de la Concorde and a 2-minute walk from Madeleine Metro Station, Fauchon l'Hotel Paris offers accommodation with a fitness centre and a Beauty Spa. This property is set a short distance from attractions such as Olympia concert hall, refine shops and Opéra Garnier. Free WiFi is included.

The rooms and suites feature air conditioning, a flat-screen TV with cable channels and a kettle. They also have a private bathroom with a shower and/or bathtub, free toiletries and a hairdryer. All rooms feature a gourmet bar that can be personalized with sweet and savory Fauchon snacks and delicacies that are complimentary, as well a chilled selection of beverages.

A continental, à la carte or American breakfast is served daily at the property. The on-site restaurant specializes in French cuisine.

Fauchon l'Hotel offers a terrace.

Speaking French, English and Spanish, staff will be happy to provide guests with practical guidance on the area at the 24-hour front desk.

Tuileries Garden is an 11-minute walk from the accommodation. The nearest airport is Paris - Orly Airport, 16 km from Fauchon l'Hotel.Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 9.8 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

items.name: Hotel de Crillon
items.description:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Hotel de CrillonHotel de Crillon is set in Paris, 300 metres from both the Tuileries Garden and the Champs-Elysées and 1.5 km from the Louvre Museum. Some rooms have a balcony. The hotel features an indoor swimming pool and a spa.

Each room at Hotel de Crillon provides Rivolta Carmignani Italian linen and French Drouault pillows and duvets. The spacious marble bathrooms feature underfloor heating as well as bespoke toiletries and a bathroom mirror with an inset television. A walk-in rain shower and a bath are also provided. In-room check-in and a Bluetooth sound system are available.

In our gastronomic restaurant L’Écrin*, we invite you to an exceptional culinary experience characterized by the subtlety of our dishes and remarkable pairings.

Nonos by Paul Pairet is a delicatessen counter and the deliciously moreish recreation of the Hôtel de Crillon offering the very best seafood, charcuterie, smoked fish and cheeses.

Butterfly Pâtisserie, the new gourmet space in the hotel located in the heart of Paris, showcases delicacies, artful cakes, seasonal desserts and signature chocolates in a gleaming high jewellery atelier setting.

Jardin d’Hiver is the perfect cocoon in which to share a glamorous family moment or tête-à-tête. Travelers and Parisians can enjoy all-day dining or indulge their sweet tooth with splendid desserts by our Head Pastry Chef Matthieu Carlin.

Located on Place de la Concorde, the bar Les Ambassadeurs at Hôtel de Crillon, A Rosewood Hotel, epitomises the quintessential spirit of Paris. The most iconic cocktail bar in the capital.

An indoor swimming pool with atypical decoration and a fireplace area is featured. Guests can also relax in the spa or enjoy massage and beauty treatments at an extra cost. A hairdresser and fitness centre are available on site.

High-speed internet access is provided throughout. Extras include valet parking and a concierge service. The surrounding area is convenient for shopping and provides direct access to several touristic sites.

An airport shuttle is available. Orsay Museum is 1 km from Hotel de Crillon, while the Grands Magasins Department Stores can be found 1.1 km away. The nearest airport is Paris - Orly Airport, 24 km from Hotel de Crillon.Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 10.0 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

hostInfo.name: Yuna Team
hostInfo.welcomeMessage: Nestled in the heart of Montmartre, at 4 rue des Baigneurs, 75018, the Yuna Montmartre Hotel offers a charming getaway amidst the cobblestone streets and artistic allure of this iconic Parisian neighborhood. With contemporary décor, our Yuna team welcomes guests with attentive service and comfortable accommodations. Ideally located near cafes, boutiques, and art galleries, the Yuna Montmartre Hotel provides the perfect base to experience the enchanting spirit of Paris.
hostInfo.ownerInfo: The Yuna team is available 24/7 via WhatsApp or in person, ensuring convenience and support throughout your stay. Our professional and dedicated team is committed to providing a unique and memorable experience for every guest. From offering assistance to ensuring a seamless stay, we're here to make your visit extraordinary and accessible whenever you need us.
hostInfo.neighboorhoodInfo: Montmartre, situated in Paris' 18th arrondissement, is a neighborhood steeped in history and artistic legacy. Its iconic Sacré-Cœur Basilica offers stunning views of Paris. Wandering its cobblestone streets reveals its artistic heritage, from the Moulin Rouge to the Bateau-Lavoir, once home to Picasso. Places like Place du Tertre buzz with street artists. Rue des Abbesses hosts vibrant markets and eclectic boutiques. Montmartre's diverse dining scene ranges from traditional bistros to trendy cafes. Its inclusive community, from locals to expatriates, adds to its charm. Montmartre is a place where history meets creativity, captivating all who visit.

hostInfo.name: Yuna Team
hostInfo.welcomeMessage:
Welcome to Yuna Porte-Maillot, an ideal location in the heart of Paris. Our aparthotel offers an unparalleled stay experience in the City of Light. With 27 modern apartments, we provide the comfort of a home combined with the services of a high-quality hotel.

Each of our apartments is carefully designed to meet your needs. Some of them feature private terraces, offering breathtaking views of the city and an outdoor space to relax.

Our convenient luggage storage is available to safely store your bags, allowing you to enjoy your stay without any clutter. Additionally, our friendly and professional team is on hand to assist you with organizing your excursions and answering any questions you may have.

If you're here for business, our fully equipped meeting room is perfect for your meetings and conferences. Enjoy a modern and functional space, complete with all the necessary equipment to ensure the success of your professional events.

48 Rue Jacques Ibert is located in the 17th arrondissement of Paris, a vibrant and lively neighborhood, filled with restaurants, shops, and tourist attractions. The proximity to public transportation makes it easy for you to navigate the city, allowing you to explore the wonders of Paris with ease.

Whether you're visiting for business or pleasure, our aparthotel at 48 Rue Jacques Ibert is the perfect place for an unforgettable stay in Paris. Book now and let us offer you a warm welcome and first-class services to make your stay memorable.
hostInfo.ownerInfo: Yuna offers a collection of hotel apartments in the most legendary Parisian districts (Saint-Honoré, Les Halles, Blanche, Opéra LaFayette, Saint-Germain, Montmartre). All our apartments are equipped with kitchens, bedrooms with hotel quality bedding and living rooms with sofa beds. The wifi is not without remains with an ultra power connection. Access to the apartments is via a personalized code and independently. No need to wait long minutes at the reception, with Yuna, book and take possession of your hotel apartment. Our team of concierges welcome you all year round.
hostInfo.neighboorhoodInfo:
Welcome to Porte Maillot, a vibrant neighborhood nestled in the 17th arrondissement of Paris. Located on the western edge of the city, this district offers a unique blend of business, entertainment, and cultural attractions.

Porte Maillot is renowned for its bustling commercial center, featuring a myriad of shops, boutiques, and department stores. From high-end fashion brands to local artisanal products, you'll find a diverse range of shopping options to suit every taste.

This neighborhood is also home to the Palais des Congrès, a prominent conference and exhibition center, hosting a wide array of events throughout the year. Whether you're attending a business conference or catching a captivating show, this venue is a hub of activity and excitement.

Nature enthusiasts will appreciate the nearby Bois de Boulogne, one of the largest public parks in Paris. With its beautiful lakes, tranquil gardens, and numerous recreational activities, it offers a serene escape from the bustling city life.

With excellent transportation links, including the Porte Maillot metro station and bus terminals, exploring other parts of Paris is a breeze. Whether you're heading to the iconic Champs-Élysées or the historic Louvre Museum, you'll have convenient access to all the city's major attractions from this vibrant neighborhood.

hostInfo.name: Nestay
hostInfo.welcomeMessage:
To provide maximum flexibility, check-in is fully self-service. Guests are kindly requested to complete the online check-in prior to arrival in order to receive their access codes.

All accommodations include bed linen and towels, slippers, welcome toiletries (shampoo, conditioner, shower gel, toilet paper), a fully equipped kitchen with refrigerator, freezer, stovetop, and oven/microwave.

A free self-service laundry room with washing machines and dryers is available on the first floor of the property.

An elevator is available from the first floor.

Please note that the accommodations are not accessible for guests with reduced mobility.
hostInfo.ownerInfo:
NESTAY is a new generation of premium aparthotels located in the very heart of Paris, in the lively and iconic neighborhoods of Les Halles and Sentier.
Designed for travelers seeking comfort, independence, and authenticity, our aparthotels combine the freedom of an apartment with high-quality hotel services.

Our mission is to offer a warm and elegant stay, inspired by the Parisian art of living. Each NESTAY studio and apartment is individually decorated in a modern and contemporary style and fully equipped to ensure a comfortable stay, whether for a short visit or a longer stay in Paris.

We look forward to welcoming you and helping you experience Paris on foot, like a local, with the comfort and tranquility of a NESTAY aparthotel.
hostInfo.neighboorhoodInfo:
Our aparthotels enjoy an exceptional central location in Paris, in the heart of Les Halles and close to Sentier, two vibrant areas known for their shops, restaurants, and cafés.

Within a short walking distance, you can easily reach the Louvre Museum, Notre-Dame Cathedral, the Centre Pompidou, the historic Marais district.

With multiple metro and bus lines nearby, getting around Paris is effortless, although most of the city’s highlights can be discovered on foot from our location.

items.name: Hotel Astra Opera - Astotel
items.description:
This sophisticated hotel is located in the heart of Paris, between the Opera Garnier and Place de La Madeleine. It has a glass-roofed bar and stylish soundproofed rooms.

Provided with free Wi-Fi internet access, rooms at the Astra hotel come fully equipped with air conditioning and satellite TV. The private bathrooms feature a hairdryer and either a bathtub or a shower. Each room includes complimentary non-alcoholic beverages in the minibar.

A full buffet breakfast is served every morning in the elegant breakfast room. Starting in the afternoon until late in the evening, guests can also enjoy free non-alcoholic beverages and snacks in the hotel lobby. Guests can stop by any of Astotel's hotels in Paris to enjoy this service and have a drink or snack, free of charge.

The Astra Opera Hotel is close to the famous Galeries Lafayette department stores and just 200 metres from Auber RER Train Station, which gives direct access to Disneyland Paris. Havre-Caumartin Metro Station is 220 metres away.

Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 9.7 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

hostInfo.name: Maison La Bohème Montmartre
hostInfo.welcomeMessage:
Welcome to La Maison Bohème Montmartre, the highest building of Paris at 130m above sea level! By choosing us you are not choosing a hotel but a luxury studio or apartment with services. Therefore you have to keep in mind that we do not have a reception nor team on site 24/7. Also, our small 2 storey building does not have an elevator but no worries there is only a few steps.
Nestled at the very top of the Montmartre hill, between the famous Place du Tertre and the Sacré Coeur, you'll enjoy typical Parisian charm and comfort worthy of the finest Parisian hotels. 
La Maison Bohème Montmartre is a top-of-the-range establishment, ideally located in the heart of the capital, offering 14 luxurious studios and apartments with services, carefully renovated by the finest French craftsmen.
hostInfo.neighboorhoodInfo:
La Maison Bohème Montmartre is located in the heart of the iconic Montmartre district — a true village within the city. You'll be just steps away from the Sacré-Cœur, cobbled streets lined with artists' studios, and the legendary Place du Tertre.
Here, the bohemian spirit of Paris blends with lively local life, surrounded by historic cafés, neighborhood markets, and art galleries.
Far from the main tourist crowds, yet close to everything, Montmartre offers a unique and inspiring atmosphere.

items.name: Shangri-La Paris
items.description:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Shangri-La ParisA former residence of Prince Roland Bonaparte and listed in the French “Monuments Historiques”, Shangri-La Paris is a hotel palace located across the Seine and facing the Eiffel Tower. It reflects both Asian hospitality and French art de vivre. It has 2 restaurants. An indoor pool and a spa are featured. Place Trocadero can be found 500 metres away.

Some rooms and suites at Shangri-La  Paris offer stunning and unique views of the Eiffel Tower. Apart from the Signature Suites, all rooms and suites are decorated in shades of blue, white and ecru, in keeping with both European Empire and Asian aesthetics. All rooms have a separate living room with desk and a marble bathroom with heated flooring, separate bath and rainfall shower and Guerlain toiletries. The rooms and suites feature custom-made furniture with crystal finishing. A flat-screen TV with in-house movie channels, an iPod dock and a laptop safe are provided.

Enjoy our four restaurants, including Shang Palace where guests can enjoy breakfast, lunch and dinner in the glass-roofed dining room.
Le Bar Botaniste provides rare botanical spirits to match with a large menu of cocktail creations and liquors. Its four historical reception rooms can welcome prestigious events and weddings.

Shangri-La Paris offers wellness and leisure services which include an indoor swimming pool and fitness room bathed with natural daylight. The swimming pool is located in Roland Bonaparte’s former stables. A hammam and in-room relaxing spa experiences are available. Guests can also enjoy the historic billiard room with complete with a fireplace.

An airport shuttle is available at Shangri-La  Paris. Iena Metro Station is just 100 metres away, while the prestigious avenue Montaigne and the Champs-Elysées are both 1.1 km from the property. Parc des Princes Stadium is located 5 km from Shangri-La while Orly Airport is 19 km away.Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 9.7 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

items.description:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Hotel SAX Paris, LXR Hotels & ResortsElegant Accommodation: Hotel SAX Paris in Paris offers a 5-star experience with spa facilities, a sauna, a year-round outdoor swimming pool, and a lush garden. Guests enjoy free WiFi, a terrace, and a modern restaurant.

Comfortable Amenities: The hotel features a fitness room, hot tub, steam room, and beauty services. Additional amenities include a hammam, yoga classes, and a tour desk. Family rooms and a 24-hour front desk cater to all needs.

Dining Options: A family-friendly restaurant serves French, Japanese, and international cuisines. Breakfast includes American and buffet options with fresh pastries, pancakes, cheese, fruits, and juice. Dining options include brunch, lunch, dinner, high tea, and cocktails.

items.name: Le Meurice – Dorchester Collection
items.description:
You might be eligible for a Genius discount at Le Meurice – Dorchester Collection. To check if a Genius discount is available for your selected dates sign in.


Genius discounts at this property are subject to book dates, stay dates and other available deals.

Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Le Meurice – Dorchester CollectionLe Meurice stands at the heart of Paris, carrying nearly two centuries of French cultural life within its walls. Overlooking the Tuileries Garden, it remains a house where creativity and intellect feel entirely at home.

Since 1835, this address has welcomed those who shape ideas and influence culture. Salvador Dalí made it his Paris residence for many years, receiving guests each afternoon in a ritual that became part of the hotel’s legend. That spirit of artistic presence and intellectual exchange continues today, woven into the life of the house. Art is selected with discernment and delight. Gastronomy reflects the discipline and imagination of French excellence. Craftsmanship, rooted in ateliers across the country, finds contemporary expression in rooms composed with clarity and proportion.

Cultural authority is carried with composure. Heritage guides the present, insightfully informing partnerships and programming. Guests sense depth and credibility in the atmosphere, supported by knowledge, taste and quiet confidence.

Conversation shapes daily life at Le Meurice. From morning coffee overlooking the gardens to evenings that stretch gently across the table, the house encourages exchange, curiosity and connection. Service is guided by attentiveness and warmth, creating an environment where guests feel recognised and understood. Relationships form naturally here, grounded in respect and genuine interest.

Light moves through grand salons and across gilded detail, bringing warmth and energy to classical spaces. There is radiance in the proportions, in the wit that surfaces at the right moment, and in the ease with which grandeur is expressed. The atmosphere feels uplifting and deeply lived, shaped as much by the people within it as by the architecture itself.

Le Meurice remains what it has long been: a hotel of artists and thinkers, where culture continues to evolve, conversation carries meaning and French heritage shapes a way of life defined by clarity, warmth and presence.Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 9.8 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

items.description:
Ideally situated just a 5-minute walk from the Champs Elysées and Franklin D. Roosevelt Metro Station, the Hotel Rond-Point offers a 13-metres indoor pool with a hammam and relaxation area. Guests can savour a drink at the Daphné bar.

Decorated in a Art Deco-style, each room is equipped with free high-speed WiFi access, a flat-screen satellite TV and tea and coffee making facilities. All rooms also have a cordless phone with a 4G Internet connection and unlimited national and international calls. Rooms have a private bathroom with a hairdryer, free Sothys toiletries and a bath or shower. Bathrobes and slippers are provided.

In the morning, a sweet and savoury breakfast is provided in the restaurant or in the comfort of your room.

The Eiffel Tower and Louvre Museum are a 16-minute journey by public transport.The hotel can also help you organise your trip in Paris.Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 9.7 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

items.description:
You might be eligible for a Genius discount at Terrass" Hotel. To check if a Genius discount is available for your selected dates sign in.


Genius discounts at this property are subject to book dates, stay dates and other available deals.

Le Terrass” Hôtel is set in a 19th century building in the heart of the Montmartre district. Just a 15-minute walk from the Sacré-Coeur Basilica, the 4-star hotel offers elegantly decorated rooms with air conditioning.

Serviced by 2 lifts, all rooms are equipped with a flat-screen satellite TV, free WiFi access, a minibar and a private bathroom.

Guests can admire the Eiffel Tower when having breakfast on the rooftop terrace of Le Terrass” Restaurant Bar. Its panoramic terrace features large bay windows and offers clear views of Paris.

A 24-hour front desk with concierge service is provided. Free internet facilities are available.

Guests can explore the picturesque Montmartre district or go to the Moulin Rouge, which is 450 metres away. Metro Blanche (line 2) is 500 metres from the hotel and allows direct access to the Arc de Triomphe. The Grands Magasins department stores and Opéra are a 20-minute walk away.Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 9.6 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

items.name: Esteem Tour Eiffel
items.description:
Esteem Tour Eiffel is located in Paris’ 15th arrondissement, a 10-minute walk from the Eiffel Tower. It offers individually decorated rooms, just a 5-minute walk from Charles Michels Metro Station.

A safe and a work desk are basic facilities in all of the rooms at Esteem Tour Eiffel. Each has a TV with satellite channels and an en suite bathroom with amenities.

Featuring a painted mural, the breakfast room serves fresh croissants every morning. Guests can also relax in the lounge and read one of the newspapers on offer.

In the heart of the Beaugrenelle district, Esteem Tour Eiffel is a 7-minute walk from the Seine and 1.5 k from Porte de Versailles Exhibition Centre. Local transport links lead directly to Jardin des Plantes and the Sorbonne University.

In the heart of the Beaugrenelle district, near the Seine riverfront and a stone's throw from the Eiffel Tower, our Parisian establishment welcomes you in a decor that combines comfort and authenticity during your trips to the capital.

We pay particular attention to the relationship between our teams and you.

Nestled in the heart of the Beaugrenelle/Saint-Charles district, surrounded by tourist monuments, quality restaurants and an exceptional shopping center, we are ideally located for your business and personal travels.

A pre-authorization corresponding to the amount of the first night will be made at the time of booking.Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 9.5 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

items.name: Hôtel d'Orsay - Esprit de France
items.description:
Located in a 18th-century building on Paris left bank, the Hotel d'Orsay is a lovely  place to enjoy the charm of the city. Its central location is very convenient to discover the town and its wonders such as the Orsay and Louvre Museums, The Eiffel Tower and Notre Dame...Assemblée Nationale Metro Station is 300 meters from the property and  provides  direct access to the other attractions of Paris.

Each of the 42 rooms is unique, decorated with antique furniture, authentic artwork and carefully selected fabrics.  All equipped with a flat-screen TV,  free WiFi access and air conditionning.

A buffet breakfast is provided every morning and a continental one can be enjoyed in the comfort of the guest rooms. The Hotel d'Orsay also offers free coffee and tea at any time in the lobby but also a tea time with cake and biscuits during the afternoon.

Our front desk team remain at the guests disposal 24h/24 , always willing to assist and provide some good advices regarding conciergerie (restaurants, tickets, taxis....).Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 9.8 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

items.name: Hôtel Plaza Athénée - Dorchester Collection
items.description:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Hôtel Plaza Athénée - Dorchester CollectionHôtel Plaza Athénée is where avenue Montaigne sets the pace, and Paris takes its lead.

Since 1913, this house has held a particular kind of Parisian confidence. Shaped by couture, art, conversation and appetite, it absorbs the life of the street and concentrates it into one address. The red awnings signal arrival. The revolving doors mark a threshold. You step inside, and the city sharpens into focus.

In 1947, Christian Dior chose this neighbourhood because he recognised its creative force. That relationship continues to shape the spirit of Plaza Athénée, most visibly through the Dior Spa, and more quietly through the way the house thinks about creativity, craft and presence. Haute couture here is a culture rather than a reference. Precision, discernment and timing guide everything. Care is made to measure. Elegance is held with such ease that it never needs to announce itself. Guests often feel it first in themselves, a subtle shift in posture, pace and confidence. The welcome is warm and intelligent. Discretion is paired with personality. There is humour here, and a distinctly Parisian impertinence, delivered with charm.

Hôtel Plaza Athénée has a natural social instinct. It knows how to gather a room and allow connection to unfold without effort. Guests feel part of something alive, without ever having to perform. Each space carries its own energy. La Galerie brightens with conversation and familiar faces. Le Relais Plaza holds its Art Deco assurance as long lunches stretch into evening. Le Bar gathers momentum early, lighting the night from the inside out. This is the Plaza tempo, and it stays with people long after they leave.

Hôtel Plaza Athénée expresses Paris as a way of life. A place where heritage and modernity sit comfortably together. Where glamour has wit. Where excellence creates ease. Where the city feels fully alive, and people feel more themselves.
Plaza Athénée is where Paris lives, illuminated in a way that only the Plaza knows.Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 9.9 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

items.name: Le 123 Sébastopol - Astotel
items.description:
Located in the 2nd district of Paris, just 150 metres from Réamur-Sébastopol Metro Station, 123 Sébastopol offers a terrace, 24-hour reception and luggage storage. Place de la République is only a 10-minute walk away.

With a cinema-inspired décor, all rooms are air-conditioned and has a flat-screen TV, a minibar with free soft drinks. The en suite bathroom includes a hairdryer. Each floor pays tribute to a specific cinema artist and each room includes complimentary non-alcoholic beverages in the minibar.

A buffet breakfast is served each morning at 123 Sébastopol and it can also be enjoyed in the comfort of your own room. Restaurants can be found within walking distance. Starting in the afternoon until late in the evening, guests can also enjoy free non-alcoholic beverages and snacks in the hotel lobby. Guests can stop by any of Astotel's hotels in Paris to enjoy this service and have a drink or snack, free of charge.

Additional features include free Wi-Fi access throughout, an elevator and daily newspapers are available for free. Les Halles Shopping Centre is a 10-minute walk away and the Louvre Museum is 1.5 km from the hotel.Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 9.4 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

Located in Paris, this former 1930s tap factory now functions as a hotel. It is a 12-minute walk from Gare du Nord Train Station and free services include a concierge, luggage storage, Wi-Fi access, ironing facilities, room service and a 24-hour reception.

All air-conditioned and soundproofed rooms at Le Robinet d’Or have a wooden floor, a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, tea and coffee making facilities and an iPod docking station. The en suite bathroom includes free luxury toiletries, a hairdryer and magnifying mirrors.

The Canal Saint-Martin is 50 metres away, Gare de l'Est Train Station is a 7-minute walk away from the hotel. items.name: Le Bristol Paris, Oetker Hotels
items.description:
Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Le Bristol Paris, Oetker HotelsLe Bristol Paris is an icon of French elegance and art de vivre located at one of the city’s most prestigious addresses on rue du Faubourg Saint-Honoré. The first of only 31 hotels in France to receive the “Palace” distinction, the hotel is a brief walk from a handful of other iconic palaces, most notably the Élysée, the Grand Palais and the Louvre.
Now completely renovated, the 190 rooms and suites — among the largest in Paris — maintain all of their classic sophistication with furnishings from the Louis XV and Louis XVI eras and original artworks, complemented by a bright, contemporary palette of soft hues, sumptuous woodwork and noble interiors. Views to one side extend over Paris’s rooftops, all the way to the Eiffel Tower and Montmartre. To the other, a lush 13,000 square foot courtyard garden offers a soothing oasis of greenery and calm.

Le Bristol is perhaps best known for its outstanding dining tradition that the hotel has engendered for over 20 years. Epicure, Le Bristol’s premier dining experience for its tasting menu and award-winning wine list, has held 3 Michelin stars since 2009. 114 Faubourg, a classic brasserie-style restaurant, has maintained its Michelin star since 2013.
The two restaurants offer a rarefied encounter with regionally sourced ingredients transformed into delicious dishes by expert hands, to be enjoyed with homemade ancient grain bread produced entirely in-house — from mill, to hearth, to plate.

A spirit of joie de vivre permeates the hotel from early morning to after midnight. Café Antonia is a quiet refuge for a light meal or afternoon tea lavish with sweet treats by Head of Pastry Chef, taken either in the lobby bar or (season permitting) in the spectacular courtyard garden. As night falls, Le Bar du Bristol awakens, low lit in purple neon, for the utterly Parisian B.A.D. (Bristol After Dark) evening. The extraordinary rooftop swimming pool and outdoor sun terrace, a fully equipped fitness gym, a steam room and the award-winning The Spa Le Bristol by La Mer provide luxurious avenues of wellbeing to counterbalance the hedonistic pleasures. And, never overlooked, precious younger guests can enjoy spa treatments designed exclusively for children in collaboration with Bonpoint.

Genuine Parisian elegance since 1925.Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 9.9 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

translations.name: Suite Imperiale
translations.description:
The 3,475-square-foot Imperial Suite is the largest suite at the Palace-awarded Le Bristol.

Tranquil, elegant and bathed in natural light, this suite balances expansive space with a delightful intimacy. The honey-coloured parquet floor in a chevron pattern in the entrance hall sets the tone for refinement and craftsmanship throughout.

Overlooking the hotel’s exquisite 12,900-square-foot French garden, the dining area can accommodate up to 12 guests for an unforgettable culinary experience authored by our Chef Arnaud Faye.

Floral tones by Manuel Canovas and Veraseta dress the main bedroom. A serene space, it features a sitting area, two large dressing rooms and a 270-square-foot bathroom.

The cool and luxurious bathroom has a deep bathtub, separate rain shower and twin vanity. The surprise of a reinvigorating steam room creates a haven of relaxation enjoy.

This suite can offer 3 bedrooms furnished with sky-blue floral fabrics from Canovas, to welcome families.

A stay at Le Bristol is a celebration of delight and pleasure.

items.description:
You might be eligible for a Genius discount at Grands Boulevards Experimental. To check if a Genius discount is available for your selected dates sign in.


Genius discounts at this property are subject to book dates, stay dates and other available deals.

Inspired by the building’s history and Marie Antoinette, the interior seduces the senses blending romance and aristocracy with a nod to mischief. Each of our 50 bedrooms is unique! From the canopy bed, the colors of each bathroom and the delicate tile work, guests are invited to enjoy a relaxing night in our handmade linen from Brittany. Pure bliss, a home away from home.
In the heart of Paris, just a stone's throw away from the Opera and close to the Louvre, and postcard streets from Le Marais, our hotel provides a tranquil escape from the bustling Grands Boulevards. The prestigious Grands Magasins are a mere 15 minutes away on foot, and the serene Tuileries Gardens can be reached in 20 minutes. Conveniently, the Grands Boulevards metro station is right in front of the entrance.

The neighbourhood is vibrant with cultural life, home to numerous theaters and bars with terraces. One can find the Bourse district with its passages cherished by the Surrealists, the Sentier with its remarkable pool of entrepreneurs, the Faubourg Montmartre with its theaters, the Faubourg Poissonnière with its trendy restaurants, and Strasbourg Saint-Denis with its sleepless streets. Just steps away, Le Grand Rex cinema stands as a stunning example of Art Deco, enhancing the cultural allure surrounding our hotel.Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 9.4 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

You might be eligible for a Genius discount at Helussi Hôtel. To check if a Genius discount is available for your selected dates sign in.


Genius discounts at this property are subject to book dates, stay dates and other available deals.

Located in the 9th district of Paris, just a 15-minute walk from the Montmartre area, Helussi Hôtel offers a free sauna, 24-hour reception and luggage storage. Poissonnière Metro Station is 190 metres away and offers direct access to the Louvre Museum.

All rooms are air-conditioned and feature a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, a safety deposit box and a wardrobe. The en suite bathroom includes a hairdryer.

Breakfast is served from 7am to 11am and is offered at a rate of 16.00€ and it can also be served in the comfort of your own room. Restaurants can be found within walking distance.

Additional features include free WiFi access throughout, a business centre with a shared TV and a lift. The Opéra Garnier is a 20-minute walk away and Gare du Nord Train Station is ideally located 950 metres from the hotel. Private parking is possible nearby, upon request and is subject to availability.Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 9.4 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

hostInfo.name: My Maison In Paris
hostInfo.welcomeMessage:
My Maison In Paris - Invalides is a building with several apartments, a gym (open from 6 am to 10 pm), and a rooftop with a unique view of the Eiffel Tower (accessible only by stairs and open from 9 am to 6 pm).
 
Each apartment is thoughtfully decorated in the timeless spirit of Parisian interiors — a refined blend of contemporary design, unique styles, and familiar, comforting touches. The result is a warm, inviting space that instantly makes you feel at home, even while you're away.
 
Apartments with similar features are grouped into categories. We regularly update our listings with detailed descriptions and a wide selection of photos to give you the most precise possible idea of what to expect.
 
Please note, however, that the photos are non-contractual. Layouts and furnishings may vary slightly between apartments, but all offer the same high standard of comfort and style. Your apartment will be assigned based on availability.
 
You will receive an email the evening before your arrival (around 8:00 PM local time) with your apartment number and all necessary access information.

As apartments, we do not have a reception desk at the entrance. However, we are on-site during working hours (9.30 am - 6 pm).

The cleaning will be done before your arrival and at the end of your stay by our dedicated team. We sincerely wish to provide you with a "pied-à-terre" experience to make you feel at home. Therefore, your stay does not include daily cleaning or replacement amenities and towels.
 
If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to us at any time.
 
Thank you for being so understanding, and we look forward to welcoming you soon.
hostInfo.ownerInfo:
FOUNDED IN 2017 BY A COLLECTIVE OF FRIENDS KEEN TO RESTORE FUN AND FLUIDITY TO GROUP AND FAMILY TRAVEL. MY MAISON IN PARIS HAS QUICKLY BECOME THE GO-TO REFERENCE FOR HOSPITALITY (À LA) PARIS.

Their ambition?
To create warm, kid-friendly places that embody the Parisian lifestyle and offer an escape from the rigidity of the classic hotel business. Opting for My Maison in Paris means choosing freedom of movement, but also freedom of pace. Have breakfast on a café terrace, or prepare brunch at La Maison. With family or friends, in a typical cocoon, you can live your stay as you wish. Immerse yourself in the most beautiful city in the world and live like a Parisian. Buy your newspaper, make yourself a coffee or enjoy a cheese platter after visiting all the city's museums...
‍
Better than a hotel, an apartment
The country of art de vivre, France is a benchmark for the whole world. The My Maison in Paris apartments are the expression of this. A true standard of quality, the label offers guests the experience of living like a Parisian and not just a tourist. From decor and amenities to peace of mind, everything is designed for total immersion in authentic Paris.

Featuring a classic decor, this room includes satellite TV, a radio and free Wi-Fi. Some of these rooms feature exposed beams.

No extra beds or baby cots are possible in this room.

translations.name: Deluxe Double Room with Spa Bath
translations.description:
Featuring a classic decor, this room includes satellite TV, a radio and free Wi-Fi. Some of these rooms feature exposed beams.

Please note that the spa tub is not a Jacuzzi.

translations.name: Junior Suite with Spa Bath
translations.description:
Featuring a classic decor, this room has antique furniture and exposed beams. It includes a spa bath in the en suite bathroom.

Please note that the spa tub is not a Jacuzzi.

facilities.name: Internet
facilities.overview: WiFi is available in all areas and is free of charge.

facilities.name: Parking
facilities.overview: Private parking is possible at a location nearby (reservation is needed) and costs € 49 per day.
